title: An Empirical Study on the Characteristics of Bias upon Context Length Variation for Bangla

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using embedding extraction techniques (WEAT, SEAT, and CEAT) and a mask prediction approach (Log Probability Bias Score Test) to calculate association metrics between male/female target words and attributes (such as career vs. family, math/science vs. arts, and pleasant vs. unpleasant) across different context lengths in Bangla language models.
